title: Apéry-type approximations and irrationality measures for certain $q$-series
summary: We construct a three-parameter family of rational approximations to values of $q$-hypergeometric series. Using these approximations, we prove that, for every integer $x$ with $|x|\geq2$, the values at $r=x^{-1}$ of Ramanujan's theta function $ψ(r)=\sum_{n\geq0}r^{n(n+1)/2}$, the generating function $Δ(r)=\sum_{m\geq0}d(2m+1)r^m$ of the divisor function restricted to odd integers, and the generating function $B_4(r)=\sum_{n\geq0}b_4(n)r^n$ for $4$-regular partitions are irrational.
